value.signature: fn replay (bound : & BoundProcedure < '_ > , supplied : & pn_records :: conserved :: SolveRecord ,) -> Result < pn_records :: conserved :: SolveRecord , Error >

review.body: { let rung = & supplied . rounds . first () . ok_or (Error :: Scope) ? . certified . rung ; let checked = driver :: run (bound , & supplied . fence , rung , Some (supplied)) ? ; if checked . work != supplied . replay_work { return Err (Error :: ReplayWork) ; } Ok (checked) }
review.item_premise: Only frozen public compiler inputs, rational coordinates, declared policies and checked numerical evidence enter these operations. The evaluator retains public bounds and the mandatory replay budget count; replay refuses a changed count. Separately bounded fence validation is outside this count. No private material or publication bytes enter, and no subscriber or digest is admitted.
